## Code copied into this tree

One component. Everything else is a dependency, not a copy.

| Component | Origin | Licence | Copyright |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`holos-shacl-engine`](crates/holos-shacl-engine) | [pwin/SHACL_Engine](https://github.com/pwin/SHACL_Engine) @ `874e6e57` | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | Peter Winstanley — **the same holder as this project** |

Its `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE` are kept in the crate, and
[`PROVENANCE.md`](crates/holos-shacl-engine/PROVENANCE.md) records every change
made to it. Because the upstream copyright holder and this project's are the same
person, no third-party copyright attaches to that code.

## Approaches reimplemented rather than copied

Neither of these contributed any source. A technique is not the thing a licence
covers, and reimplementing one avoids inheriting its terms.

| Idea | Origin | Its licence | Why not copied |
|---|---|---|---|
| CSV → RDF via a TARQL-style `CONSTRUCT` | [semanticarts/oxi-gen](https://github.com/semanticarts/oxi-gen) | Apache-2.0 **only** | Copying Apache-only source would force this project to Apache-only, dropping the MIT arm. A clean-room implementation was written and then dropped before 0.3.0 as an unwired feature; the licence reasoning is kept because the constraint has not changed |
| Hypertrie / worst-case-optimal joins | [Tentris](https://dice-research.org/Tentris) | varies | `DESIGN.md` §12: implement from the papers rather than copy code whose licence is unverified |

The `fn:`, `afn:` and `spif:` function libraries are implemented from their
published specifications (W3C XPath F&O, Apache Jena ARQ documentation, SPIN).
Function signatures and semantics are specifications, not source, and the
implementations here were written for this project.

### Requiring anything of us

**None.** No copyleft licence without a permissive alternative, and no crate
with an undeclared licence.

### Apache-2.0 only

Depending on these does **not** affect this project's licence: linking against
permissively-licensed code imposes nothing on the code that links it. What
Apache-2.0 §4 does ask is that attribution and any `NOTICE` travel with a
**binary distribution**, so a released binary should carry this file.

| Crate | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `approx` | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/brendanzab/approx |
| `clang-sys` | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/KyleMayes/clang-sys |
| `rocksdb` | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/rust-rocksdb/rust-rocksdb |
| `target-lexicon` | Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception | https://github.com/bytecodealliance/target-lexicon |

## Test suites

The W3C RDF, SPARQL and SHACL test suites are **fetched, not committed**
(`scripts/fetch-testsuites.sh`) and are excluded by `.gitignore`. They are W3C
material under the W3C Test Suite Licence, and keeping them out of the tree avoids
redistributing third-party fixtures under terms different from this project's.
